calling_earth.narration.1: Uh-oh. One of our solar arrays is flickering.
calling_earth.narration.2: Let’s call Mission Control on Earth! But Mars is very far away.
calling_earth.narration.3: Our signal takes about 12 minutes to get there, and 12 more for the answer to come back.
calling_earth.dialogue.1: We could wait for Earth, or I could try fixing it now.
calling_earth.dialogue.2: Waiting uses power too. What do you think, Commander?
calling_earth.question: What now?
calling_earth.A.label: Wait for Earth (Power −8 while waiting, then Earth’s tip gives Power +5 and a safe fix)
calling_earth.A.after: Dr. Thiri’s tip fixed it safely! Waiting cost us some power, but we learned a new trick.
calling_earth.reply.A: Hello, Commander! Thanks for your call. Let’s look at that array together.
calling_earth.B.label: Fix it now with Kai (Power −10, fixed)
calling_earth.B.after: Kai fixed it fast, all on our own! Deciding without help from Earth is part of life on Mars.
calling_earth.C.label: Ignore it and keep researching (Science +2, the flicker returns bigger on Sol 7)
calling_earth.C.after: We got extra science, but the flicker is still there. Small problems can come back bigger.
calling_earth.classroom: Why could Earth not answer straight away?
calling_earth.cargo.radio_booster: The booster helped us use Earth’s tip. The message still took time to travel.
